# Luis Cabrera

> Software engineer at P&G in Warsaw. I build mobile apps with Flutter/Dart and agentic systems.

Before software engineering I spent five years in product and operations roles at Mercado Libre, a logistics SaaS company (Foxtrot Systems, Descartes) and P&G, most recently as a product manager on Pampers messaging and CRM. I have an MSc in Big Data & Advanced Analytics from SGH Warsaw School of Economics (2025) and a BS in Industrial Engineering from Instituto Politécnico Nacional (IPN).

- traX: personal health tracking and longevity insights (alpha).
